heading: A small crew, working close to home.
lede: At Whitetail Painting Solutions we believe everyone deserves to be proud of their home.
whoBody:
We are a painting company in Juniata County. The work is better when the same people show up each morning and the owner is on the job, so that is how we run it.

Most of what we do comes from somebody telling a neighbor about us. That only keeps working if we treat your house the way we would want ours treated, so that is the whole plan.

It also means we take on fewer jobs at once than a bigger outfit would. If we are booked a few weeks out, we will tell you that instead of squeezing you in and rushing it.
